WITH station_averages AS (
  SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusage
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
), baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusage
  FROM telescopes
)
SELECT AVG(s.avg_bandusage) AS mean_station_average,
       AVG(s.avg_bandusage - b.avg_bandusage) AS mean_excess_over_baseline
FROM station_averages AS s
CROSS JOIN baseline AS b
WHERE s.avg_bandusage > b.avg_bandusage;
